name: Tropical Kingbird
powerText: If this is the rightmost bird in its habitat, move it with the action cube to another habitat and continue your turn in the new habitat.

name: Tropical Parula
powerText: Attract or return 1 [bee] or [topaz] hummingbird.

name: Tropical Royal Flycatcher
powerText: Give 1 [invertebrate] from your personal supply to another player to gain 2 [invertebrate] from the general supply.

name: Trumpeter Finch
powerText: Play 1 additional bird in your [grassland]. You may ignore 1 [seed] or 1 [egg] in its cost.

name: Tufted Puffin
powerText: Roll all dice not in the birdfeeder 3 consecutive times. Each time, cache all [fish] rolled on this bird.

name: Tufted Titmouse
powerText: Play an additional bird in your [forest]. Pay its normal cost.

name: Tundra Swan
powerText: When another player takes the “draw cards” action, draw 1 [card] from the deck at the end of their turn.

name: Turkey Vulture
powerText: When another player's [predator] succeeds, gain 1 [die] from the birdfeeder.

name: Turquoise-Browed Motmot
powerText: All players may return 1 hummingbird, starting with the player of your choice.

name: Twite
powerText: Draw 2 [card] from the deck and add them to your hand. Then, tuck any 2 [card] from your hand behind this bird.

name: Tūī
powerText: Copy a brown power on one bird in the [forest] of the player to your left.

name: Ultramarine Grosbeak
powerText: Play another bird in this column, leaving no empty spaces to its left. Pay its normal cost.

name: Vampire Ground-Finch
powerText: Lay 1 [egg] on each bird with a [wild] symbol in its food cost.

name: Variable Oystercatcher
powerText: Shuffle the discard pile, then draw [card] from it equal to the number of players + 1. Starting with you, each player keeps 1 of those cards, and you also keep the last card.

name: Variable Seedeater
powerText: Discard 1 [seed] to lay 1 [egg] each on the bird(s) immediately to the left and right of this bird. You may discard 1 additional [seed] to lay 1 [egg] on this bird.

name: Varied Thrush
powerText: For each bird in your [forest] with [invertebrate] or [fruit] in its food cost, including this one, cache 1 [invertebrate] or [fruit] on this bird from the supply.

name: Vaux's Swift
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind this bird. If you do, gain 1 [invertebrate] from the supply.

name: Verdin
powerText: Discard 1 [invertebrate] to take 1 hummingbird action.

name: Verditer Flycatcher
powerText: If you have gained a [invertebrate] from the birdfeeder on this turn, gain 1 [fruit] from the supply.

name: Vermilion Flycatcher
powerText: Attract or return 1 [bee] or [brilliant] hummingbird.

name: Violet Cuckoo
powerText: When another player takes the “lay eggs” action, lay 1 [egg] on another bird with wingspan less than 30 cm. You may go 2 over its egg limit while using this power.

name: Violet-Green Swallow
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 [card].

name: Virginia Rail
powerText: Discard any number of [card] from your hand, then draw that many [card]. Draw 1 additional [card].

name: Wattled Jacana
powerText: Refill the bird tray. If you do, you may trade 1 [card] from your hand with 1 [card] in the tray.

name: Wedge-Tailed Eagle
powerText: Look at a [card] from the deck. If its wingspan is over 65cm, tuck it behind this bird and cache 1 [rodent] from the supply on this bird. If not, discard it.

name: Weka
powerText: When another player resets the birdfeeder, cache 1 [die] from the birdfeeder on this bird at the end of their turn.

name: Welcome Swallow
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from the deck behind each bird in this habitat, including this bird.

name: Western Capercaillie
powerText: Draw 2 new bonus cards. Keep 1 and give 1 to another player.

name: Western House Martin
powerText: For each type of food in the personal supply of the player to your left, gain 1 food of that type from the general supply.

name: Western Jackdaw
powerText: Cache up to 3 [wild] from your supply on this bird. For each, gain 1 [die] from the birdfeeder.

name: Western Meadowlark
powerText: All players lay 1 [egg] on any 1 [ground] bird. You may lay 1 [egg] on 1 additional [ground] bird.

name: Western Rockhopper Penguin
powerText: Discard 1 [fish] to draw 2 [card]. You may tuck 1 or both of them behind this bird.

name: Western Screech-Owl
powerText: Roll all [die] that are in the birdfeeder. Cache 1 [invertebrate] and/or 1 [rodent] on this bird, if available, then reset the birdfeeder.

name: Western Tanager
powerText: Gain 1 [invertebrate] or [fruit] from the birdfeeder, if available.

name: Western Yellow Wagtail
powerText: For each bonus card you score for which this bird qualifies, it counts double.

name: Whiskered Treeswift
powerText: Cache 1 [invertebrate] from your supply on this bird to draw 1 [card] from the deck.

name: White Stork
powerText: Discard all remaining face-up [card] and refill the tray. If you do, draw 1 of the new face-up [card].

name: White Wagtail
powerText: If you used all 4 types of actions this round, play another bird. Pay its normal food and egg cost.

name: White-Backed Woodpecker
powerText: Gain 1 [die] from the birdfeeder.

name: White-Bellied Sea-Eagle
powerText: Reset the birdfeeder. Gain 1 [fish] or 1 [rodent] from the birdfeeder, if there is one, and cache it on this bird.

name: White-Breasted Nuthatch
powerText: Cache 1 [seed] from the supply on this bird.

name: White-Breasted Woodswallow
powerText: Lay 1 [egg] on each bird in your [grassland], including this one.

name: White-Browed Tit-Spinetail
powerText: For each bird in your [forest], draw 1 new bonus card; keep 1.

name: White-Browed Tit-Warbler
powerText: For each bird in your [forest] with an egg on it, roll any 1 [die]. Choose 1 type of food you rolled and gain 1 of that food from the supply.

name: White-Crested Laughingthrush
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind this bird. If you do, gain 1 [invertebrate], [seed], or [fruit] from the birdfeeder.

name: White-Crowned Sparrow
powerText: If this bird is to the right of all other birds in its habitat, move it to another habitat.

name: White-Faced Heron
powerText: Reset the birdfeeder and gain all [fish], if there are any. You may cache any or all of them on this bird.

name: White-Faced Ibis
powerText: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are [fish], cache 1 [fish] from the supply on this bird.

name: White-Headed Duck
powerText: Draw 3 new bonus cards and keep 1.

name: White-Throated Dipper
powerText: Discard all remaining face-up [card] and refill the tray. If you do, draw 1 of the new face-up [card].

name: White-Throated Kingfisher
powerText: Choose any 1 [die]. Roll it up to 3 times. Each time, if you roll a [invertebrate], [fish], or [rodent], cache 1 here. If not, stop and return all food cached here this turn.

name: White-Throated Magpie-Jay
powerText: Choose any number of birds adjacent to this one and tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind each. For each, draw 1 [card] from the deck.

name: White-Throated Swift
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind this bird. If you do, lay 1 [egg] on any bird.

name: White-Tipped Dove
powerText: Choose up to 3 birds with [seed] in their food cost. Cache 1 [seed] from the supply on each.

name: Whooper Swan
powerText: Choose 1–3 birds in this column. Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind each. If you tuck at least 1 card, draw 1 [card].

name: Whooping Crane
powerText: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.

name: Willet
powerText: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are [fish], cache 1 [fish] from the supply on this bird.

name: Willie-Wagtail
powerText: Draw 1 face-up [card] from the tray with a [bowl] or [star] nest. You may reset or refill the tray before doing so.

name: Willow Tit
powerText: Cache 1 [invertebrate], [seed], or [fruit] from the birdfeeder on this bird, if there is one.

name: Willow Warbler
powerText: Choose 1 other player. For each action cube on their [forest], tuck 1 [card] from the deck behind this bird.

name: Wilson's Snipe
powerText: All players draw 1 [card] from the deck.

name: Wilson's Storm Petrel
powerText: Draw 1 [card] for each empty card slot in this row. At the end of your turn, keep 1 and discard the rest.

name: Wood Duck
powerText: Draw 2 [card]. If you do, discard 1 [card] from your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Wood Stork
powerText: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.

name: Wrybill
powerText: Look through all discarded bonus cards. Keep 1 of them.

name: Yellow Bittern
powerText: Draw the [card] in the middle slot of the bird tray.

name: Yellow Warbler
powerText: All other players draw 2 from the deck, keep 1, and give 1 to you. Draw 2 additional cards from the deck, then keep 2 cards and discard the rest.

name: Yellow-Bellied Sapsucker
powerText: Gain 1 [invertebrate] from the supply.

name: Yellow-Billed Cuckoo
powerText: When another player takes the “lay eggs” action, lay 1 [egg] on a bird with a [bowl] nest.

name: Yellow-Billed Magpie
powerText: Activate each “When Activated” (brown) [predator] power. For each that succeeds, also cache 1 [wild] from the supply on this bird.

name: Yellow-Breasted Chat
powerText: If this bird is to the right of all other birds in its habitat, move it to another habitat.

name: Yellow-Eyed Penguin
powerText: Draw 5 [card] from the deck. You may play one of those birds for free; discard the rest. If it has [fish] in its food cost, cache 2 [fish] from the supply on this bird.

name: Yellow-Headed Blackbird
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind this bird. If you do, you may also lay 1 [egg] on this bird.

name: Yellow-Headed Caracara
powerText: If there is an [invertebrate] or [rodent] in the birdfeeder immediately after another player resets it, cache 1 of that food from the supply on this bird.

name: Yellow-Rumped Warbler
powerText: Tuck 1 [card] from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 [card].

name: Yellowhammer
powerText: If you used all 4 types of actions this round, play another bird. Pay its normal food and egg cost.

name: Yellowhead
powerText: Reset the birdfeeder twice. Each time, cache all [invertebrate] rolled on this bird.

name: Zebra Dove
powerText: All players may discard 1 [seed] from their supply to lay 1 [egg].
